cases.assertion: Reverse consumers have edge witnesses; owners and scenarios remain supporting.
Cycles terminate and roots have deterministic independent witnesses.
Malformed, missing and unsupported selections are visibly invalid.
Mixed scope preserves valid-root partial analysis.
Analysis writes nothing; text projects the same schema-valid report.
Supporting witnesses match the shared established context closure.
Only declared extension dependency semantics propagate potential changes.
Unavailable extension semantics do not become a safe-empty complete result.
Current applicable check plans and bindings are identified; historical records are not rebound.
Type references name their semantic dependency derivation.
Data readers/creators/writers propagate only from changed entity to consumer.
Destination changes reach navigation consumers, not vice versa.
Explicitly incomplete declared dependencies retain useful roots with partial semantics, never a complete safe result.
Malformed and unsupported files produce visible diagnostics without model mutation.
Unspecified dependency declarations remain explicit without imposing implementation readiness on model-only impact.
Only valid compatible current-model check-plan supersession retires a rerun candidate; invalid or incompatible superseders cannot retire it.
A declared binding supersession cannot retire inspection candidates without verified host trust.
